referee_caveats_inferred: Detection of the weak lines rests on moment maps made with Keplerian masks and a visually chosen velocity range; masking bias is only partly tested with unmasked profiles.
Excitation temperatures from the NOEMA plus ALMA joint fit depend on the cross-calibration of different datasets, which is not discussed.
The chemical grid is coarse (a few discrete values per parameter) and the best model still disagrees with the observed temperatures by about 10 K, so the CRI inference is model dependent.
The ring physical model (power-law structure, fixed 150 pc scaling, sigma = 0.5) is partly assumed, and the ortho-to-para correction for total H2D+ assumes thermalisation.

missing_for_reproduction: Exact line-free channel selections, self-calibration parameters and tclean cleaning thresholds
DISKFIT and IMAGER scripts and starting parameters; no analysis code released
NOEMA visibilities (Phuong 2018, 2021) must be obtained separately
DNAUTILUS 2.0 network files and the full grid outputs
reproducibility.estimated_data_volume_inferred: Two Band 7 executions with 47 antennas and six spectral windows (up to 3840 channels); roughly 20-60 GB raw, plus separate NOEMA data for the joint fit
reproducibility.score_reason: ALMA project code is given and imaging/self-calibration steps are partly described with numeric results, but key imaging settings, line-free channels, DISKFIT/IMAGER inputs, NOEMA data and the chemical network are not published.
reproducibility.rediscovery_reason: The paper does not state that the data are public, and the DISKFIT, NOEMA and DNAUTILUS parts of the recipe cannot be redone from what is printed.
